command:
set -u
ENT=/var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/lib/libmachook_ent.plist
R=/var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/lib
J=/var/jb/usr/macOS/lib
ldid -S$ENT /tmp/lm_e.new && ldid -S$ENT /tmp/lm_e.new && echo "e signed"
ldid -S$ENT /tmp/lm_a.new && ldid -S$ENT /tmp/lm_a.new && echo "a signed"
install -m755 /tmp/lm_e.new $R/libmachook.dylib.new && mv $R/libmachook.dylib.new $R/libmachook.dylib
install -m755 /tmp/lm_e.new $R/libmachook_arm64e.dylib.new && mv $R/libmachook_arm64e.dylib.new $R/libmachook_arm64e.dylib
install -m755 /tmp/lm_a.new $R/libmachook_arm64.dylib.new && mv $R/libmachook_arm64.dylib.new $R/libmachook_arm64.dylib
install -m755 /tmp/lm_e.new $J/libmachook.dylib.new && mv $J/libmachook.dylib.new $J/libmachook.dylib
install -m755 /tmp/lm_e.new $J/libmachook_arm64e.dylib.new && mv $J/libmachook_arm64e.dylib.new $J/libmachook_arm64e.dylib
install -m755 /tmp/lm_a.new $J/libmachook_arm64.dylib.new && mv $J/libmachook_arm64.dylib.new $J/libmachook_arm64.dylib
for f in $R/libmachook.dylib $R/libmachook_arm64e.dylib $R/libmachook_arm64.dylib $J/libmachook.dylib $J/libmachook_arm64e.dylib $J/libmachook_arm64.dylib; do
  python3 /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macws_boot_trust.py --readd "$f" 2>&1 | tail -1
done
rm -f /tmp/lm_e.new /tmp/lm_a.new
/var/jb/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib
for f in [\"$R/libmachook.dylib\",\"$R/libmachook_arm64.dylib\",\"$R/libmachook_arm64e.dylib\",\"$J/libmachook.dylib\",\"$J/libmachook_arm64.dylib\",\"$J/libmachook_arm64e.dylib\"]:
    print(hashlib.sha256(open(f,'rb').read()).hexdigest(), f)"
/var/jb/usr/bin/chroot /var/mnt/rootfs /bin/echo HI; echo "BASELINE_RC=$?"
